expose.title: Expose signal
expose.description: Enable exposition for this application (route based)

sleep_time.title: Sleep time
sleep_time.description: Sleep time beetween 2 checks of the targeted cluster

watch_nodes.title: Watch nodes
watch_nodes.description: Enable watching nodes health as part of the global health signal

watch_cluster_operators.title: Watch cluster operators
watch_cluster_operators.description: Enable watching cluster operator health as part of the global health signal

isDaemon.title: Cerberus is daemon
isDaemon.description: Run cerberus as a daemon (infinite loop instead of a fixed number of iterations)

mode.title: Kubeconfig mode
mode.description: Connection mode to use for the cluster (could be token, file, or local)

file.title: Kubeconfig file
file.description: If mode is file, this property must be set with a full kubeconfig content
examples:
kind: Config
apiVersion: v1
current-context: default

server.title: API endpoint
server.description: The server URL to the target cluster API

token.title: API token
token.description: The token to use to get access. A read-only access (cluster-reader) is enough

ca.title: API certificate authority
ca.description: PEM content of the certificate authority of the target cluster API

insecure.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure.description: Skip the TLS verification of the target cluster API (only used when no ca is given)

watch_url_routes.title: Watch routes
watch_url_routes.description: Url list of endpoint to watch as part of the global healthcheck (double array)

watch_terminating_namespaces.title: Watch terminating namespaces
watch_terminating_namespaces.description: Enable watching terminating namespaces as part of the global health signal

watch_namespaces.title: Watch namespaces
watch_namespaces.description: List of namespaces to watch (supports regex patterns)

watch_namespaces_ignore_pattern.title: Namespace ignore patterns
watch_namespaces_ignore_pattern.description: Regex patterns for namespaces to exclude from watching

custom_checks.title: Custom checks
custom_checks.description: List of custom check scripts to run (path relative to the cerberus working directory, ex: custom/my_check.py)

image.title: Cerberus image
image.description: Cerberus container image (pin it by digest, upstream publishes no versioned tag)

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Image tag, used when no digest is set

digest.title: Image digest
digest.description: Image digest, takes precedence over the tag

privileged.title: Privileged
privileged.description: Run the cerberus container as privileged (binds the service account to the privileged SCC)

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Resources requests and limits of the cerberus container

allowedNamespaces.title: Allowed namespaces
allowedNamespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to query the cerberus health signal (networkpolicy)

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of iterations when cerberus is not a daemon

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout of a single check (in seconds)

watch_master_schedulable.title: Watch schedulable control plane
watch_master_schedulable.description: Enable watching for schedulable control plane nodes as part of the global health signal

controlPlaneLabel.title: Control plane label
controlPlaneLabel.description: Label identifying the control plane nodes

customCheckScripts.title: Custom check scripts
customCheckScripts.description: Custom check scripts added to the cerberus configuration (file name: python content)

runAsUser.title: Run as user
runAsUser.description: User id of the cerberus container. Leave empty on OpenShift, set it on plain Kubernetes

prometheus.title: Prometheus checks
prometheus.description: Prometheus checks (API server latency, etcd leader changes)

scope.title: Scope name
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application. Define an organizational tenant.

cluster.title: Cluster name
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application. Define a platform tenant.

environment.title: Environment name
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application. Define a stage tenant.

component.title: Component name
component.description: Name of the component consisting of this application. Define a logical tenant.

app.title: Application name
app.description: Name of the application name. Define a functional tenant.

version.title: Version name
version.description: Name of the application version. Define this deployment version. Should be incremented each time application configuration is changed to keep track of changes and allow ease rollin of the application (and rollout in case of problem). Default use Chart appVersion.

enabled.title: Enable the namespace/project creation
enabled.description: Enable creation of the namespace or project. Is required to be enabled if you want to create the resource.

project.title: Project / namespace definition
project.description: Information about the project or namespace definition.

enabled.title: Enable namespace / project creation
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the project or namespace.

infra.title: Enable infra nodes
infra.description: Enable workload located into infra nodes

hooked.title: Helm hook
hooked.description: Project or namespace creation is done as an helm hook. Should be set to true if type is project (helm doesn't recognize project resource as it does for namespace)

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the project or namespace.

nodeSelector.title: Node selector
nodeSelector.description: A Node selector condition to set at the project level

type.title: Kind of resource
type.description: Kind of resource to use for namespace isolation. Project kind should be used against Openshift clusters.

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Display name of the project. Only apply to project (Openshift) type.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the project. Only apply to project (Openshift) type.

dockercfg.title: Container registry credentials
dockercfg.description: Creation of secret holding registry access credentials at the namespace level. Could be used with imagePull option available in the serviceAccount section.

enabled.title: Enable namespace scoped Dockercfg secret
enabled.description: Enable the creation of various dockercfg at the namespace / project level. This file hold credentials for container images repository access. Could be linked with service accounts (see serviceAccounts section).

name.title: Credential name
name.description: Name of the credential to create.

namespace.title: Credential namespace
namespace.description: Namespace where the credential must reside.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: Domain name of the registry to use.

username.title: User name
username.description: Name of the user used to connect to the registry.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password coresponding to the user declared for the registry access.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: Email associated to the registry user.

serviceAccounts.title: Service Account management
serviceAccounts.description: Creation of ServiceAccount. Could link secret holding registry creds using the imagePullSecrets option.

enabled.title: Enable namespace scoped serviceAccounts
enabled.description: Enable the creation of various serviceAccounts at the namespace / project level. This list hold all serviceAccounts managed by this chart.

name.title: serviceAccount name
name.description: Name of the serviceAccount to create.

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets list
imagePullSecrets.description: List of secrets used for imagePull requests.

name.title: Secret name
name.description: Name of the secret to link to this serviceAccount for imagePull.

namespace.title: Secret namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the secret to link to this serviceAccount for imagePull.

quotas.title: Quota management
quotas.description: Creation of ResourceQuota in the namespace to restrict resource consumption. see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/policy/resource-quotas

enabled.title: Enable quotas into the namespace
enabled.description: Enable the creation of ResourceQuotas in this project / namespace.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: List quotas rules to apply to this project / namespace. You can set whatever is supported in the spec of the ResourceQuota kubernetes resource. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/policy/resource-quotas for more information.

limits.title: LimitRanges management
limits.description: Creation of LimitRanges in the namespace to restrict resource consumption. see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/policy/limit-range

enabled.title: Enable limit ranges into the namespace
enabled.description: Enable the creation of LimitRanges in this project / namespace.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: List limit ranges rules to apply to this project / namespace. You can set whatever is supported in the spec of the LimitRanges kubernetes resource. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/policy/limit-range for more information.

networkpolicy.title: NetworkPolicy management
networkpolicy.description: Creation of various NetworkPolicy in the namespace to restrict network exposition. see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies

enabled.title: Enable NetworkPolicy into the namespace
enabled.description: Enable the creation of NetworkPolicies in this project / namespace.

id.title: NetworkPolicy name
id.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy to create.

spec.title: Rules
spec.description: Specification of the network policy to apply. You can set whatever is supported in the spec of the NetworkPolicy kubernetes resource. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies for more information.

rbac.title: RBAC management
rbac.description: Creation of various RBAC resources to restrict access to the namespace resources. see https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/rbac

enabled.title: Enable RBAC into the namespace
enabled.description: Enable the creation of RBAC resources in this project / namespace.

id.title: RoleBinding ID
id.description: ID of the RoleBinding to create.

name.title: Group name
name.description: Name of the group to onboard in the project.

role.title: Role name
role.description: Name of the role to give to this group.

type.title: Role type
type.description: The kind of role to use. Could be cluster or local. Default is local.

id.title: RoleBinding ID
id.description: ID of the RoleBinding to create.

name.title: User name
name.description: Name of the user to onboard in the project.

role.title: Role name
role.description: Name of the role to give to this user.

type.title: Role type
type.description: The kind of role to use. Could be cluster or local. Default is local.

enabled.title: Enable the podMonitor creation
enabled.description: Enable creation of the podMonitor in this project. Is required to be enabled if you want to create the resources.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the podMonitor. Default use the project.name value

enabled.title: Enable the serviceMonitor creation
enabled.description: Enable creation of the serviceMonitor in this project. Is required to be enabled if you want to create the resources.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the serviceMonitor. Default use the project.name value
